svg.aria-label: Six of the games as the pane draws them. Tetris: a stack with a gap and a T piece above its ghost. 2048: a 2048 tile made, scoring 23,640. Wordle: today's puzzle, ARISE and CRAMP tried, A and R yellow then C, R and A green, CRA typed on the third row, the keyboard colored below. Snake: fifteen long, food ahead. Minesweeper: an easy board half open, numbers in color, two flags placed, 41 seconds in. Connect Four: red has four on a diagonal against the Normal bot, and the line under the board says You win! with r: again and h: hub.
